text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Why is this... The wind feels so heavy.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"As if she might be knocked over by the 
slightest gentle breeze..."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Let us stay inside the room for today. 
Somewhere where the wind cannot reach...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems Yamanin Zephyr still has 
lingering fatigue from her race. It might 
be necessary to reconsider her upcoming 
race schedule.
